onboarding.title: How will you use Expire?
onboarding.subtitle: Family and business stay apart. You only see the spaces and tools for your account.
onboarding.familyBody: Home freezer, storage, and rooms you create. Invite household members later.
onboarding.businessBody: Freezer, warehouse, and rooms you create. Invite staff later.
